plugins.name: dsh-img
plugins.description: Give text-only models eyes: an analyze_image tool for DeepSeek Harness, backed by free Chinese vision APIs (GLM-4V-Flash / Qwen-VL) or any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint. 给纯文本模型装上眼睛。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代码图能力接缝（ctx.codegraph）的服务定义：图存储与图索引提供者注册表，针对八种规范化结构查询进行逐查询、顺序无关的选择

plugins.name: dsh-search-deepseek
plugins.description: 官方 DeepSeek 搜索兜底：Tavily 源全部失败或未配置时使用（会花官方余额）。由 dsh-websearch-tavily-keys-select 依赖，通常无需单独安装。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的配额监控：OpenCode Go 套餐用量 + DeepSeek API 余额/用量 + MiniMax Token Plan，作为可拖动的左下角监控窗口。P0：自计量令牌账本（llm/stream 瀑布，自有 JSONL）。P1：多提供商抽象

plugins.name: dsh-garmin-coach
plugins.description: Garmin Connect 运动健康 AI 教练插件 for DeepSeek Harness — 同步活动/健康/HRV 数据 + AI 训练建议 + 训练计划 + 训练日记
plugins.author: csustyang

description.en: SMS forwarding webhook for DeepSeek Harness: receives pushes from SMS Forwarder apps, stores them, and exposes sms_recent / sms_search tools.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a /! command trigger (run one command, analyze output, inspired by Claude Code's ! gesture) and a /terminal command (interactive PTY popup with on-demand history reference).

plugins.name: dsh-paste-spill

description.en: DSH plugin: a draggable workbench of mini-cards (API balance, token usage, session stats, goal, cost estimate) beside the conversation

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的智能 UI——模型用 DIL（Markdown + 类 JSX 标签 + JavaScript）编写界面，宿主将其编译为程序加常量表，沙箱化客户端运行时将其转为交互式文本 + 富卡片回答

description.en: DSH Web GUI typography & readability tuner: wallpaper-aware contrast repair, edge recolor and hue-cycle effects, per-content rules (bold+underlined links, tinted headings) and a floating WYSIWYG preview window.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 排版与可读性调节器：壁纸感知对比度修复、边缘重新着色与色相循环效果、按内容规则（加粗+下划线链接、着色标题）以及浮动 WYSIWYG 预览窗口。

description.en: Durable Git worktree isolation and delivery for DeepSeek Harness subagents
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 子代理提供持久的 Git worktree 隔离与交付

plugins.name: @easytz/dsh-market
plugins.description: 插件市场：搜 npm 上的 dsh 插件，一键装进当前 profile，管理已装插件与更新。Plugin market for DeepSeek Harness: search npm, one-click install, manage plugins and updates.
plugins.author: easytz

description.en: Astra - the tier every lab prices against - name reserved; first release in development.
description.zh: Astra - 每个实验室用来对标定价的层级 - 名称已保留；首个版本开发中。

description.en: Floating, draggable, resizable video scene player for DeepSeek Harness. Plays scene-per-MP4 clips from a Stash-style scene server, plus best-effort YouTube / Twitch / Jellyfin / custom links.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的浮动、可拖动、可调整大小的视频场景播放器。从 Stash 风格场景服务器播放每 MP4 一个场景的片段，并尽力支持 YouTube / Twitch / Jellyfin / 自定义链接。

description.en: Mlx - the apple silicon runtime - name reserved; first release in development.
description.zh: Mlx - apple silicon 运行时 - 名称已保留；首个版本开发中。

plugins.name: dsh-browser-polyfill
plugins.description: DSH 浏览器兼容补丁：AbortSignal.timeout/any 兼容 + 慢隧道超时放宽。老手机浏览器必备。
plugins.author: xiongjie771017

description.en: Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): CodeBuddy (copilot.tencent.com) with a runtime-synced model catalogue, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming bridge; TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local OpenAI transl
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的非官方上游捆绑包：CodeBuddy (copilot.tencent.com)，具备运行时同步的模型目录、网页搜索/抓取、图像生成和流式桥接；通过本地 OpenAI 转换接入 TraeWork CN 和 Qoder CN 订阅渠道

description.en: Image generation tool for DeepSeek Harness over any OpenAI-compatible images endpoint, with an inline Web UI gallery.
description.zh: 通过任意 OpenAI 兼容图像端点，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像生成工具，并带内联 Web UI 画廊。

description.en: OpenHarness Reader — workspace file browser/editor with Markdown preview for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: OpenHarness Reader — 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的工作区文件浏览器/编辑器，支持 Markdown 预览

description.en: API regression & acceptance workbench for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 API 回归与验收工作台。

description.en: Inject an extra system-prompt section into a DeepSeek Harness agent, shipped as a configurable bundle.
description.zh: 向 DeepSeek Harness 代理注入额外的系统提示词部分，以可配置捆绑包形式提供。

description.en: Jev-judged context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. Two layers: prune stale tool results (semantic instead of size-only), and replace spent tool-call ranges with a deterministic receipt instead of a model-written summary.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Jev 判定上下文压缩。两层：修剪过时工具结果（语义而非仅按大小），并用确定性回执替换已耗尽的工具调用范围，而非模型撰写的摘要。

description.en: Verification for DeepSeek Harness: Verify DeepSeek Harness plugins before load: manifest, hash, capability declaration, and review-record checks. Name reserved; first release in development.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 验证：在加载前验证 DeepSeek Harness 插件：manifest、hash、能力声明和审查记录检查。名称已保留；首个版本开发中。

description.en: Version pinning for DeepSeek Harness: Pin DeepSeek Harness plugins to versions you have reviewed; silent upgrades are blocked until you diff and approve them. Name reserved; first release in development.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版本固定：将 DeepSeek Harness 插件固定到你已审查的版本；在你 diff 并批准之前，静默升级会被阻止。名称已保留；首个版本开发中。

description.en: Harness bridge for the Inimerse engine and Infiverse stack: build, test, run .im scripts and drive Verse layers as first-class DSH tools.
description.zh: Inimerse 引擎与 Infiverse 技术栈的 Harness 桥接：构建、测试、运行 .im 脚本，并将 Verse 层作为一等 DSH 工具驱动。

plugins.name: dsh-todo-dock
plugins.description: DSH 右侧栏的轻量待办：一行一件、勾掉即完成、可折叠已完成；本地存储，Agent 也能加/勾/删（todo_panel 工具）。
plugins.author: lemonhall2012

plugins.name: dsh-migrate
plugins.description: DSH 配置迁移工具：导出/打包/导入 + 校验回滚（同 OS，新建 profile）。Export/package/import DSH config with verification and rollback.
plugins.author: ygcdsj

description.en: Tool-result memoization for DeepSeek Harness — TTL cache over idempotent tool calls; cache hits short-circuit re-execution with an explanatory verdict, LRU-bounded, per-tool TTLs, JSONL audit.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工具结果记忆化 — 对幂等工具调用使用 TTL 缓存；缓存命中会以带说明的判定短路重新执行，LRU 限制，按工具 TTL，JSONL 审计。
